name: Maya Torres
voice: Bright and quick, smiles on the phone, always names herself and asks good questions. Fills a silence instead of letting the caller think. Early on she quotes and stops; later she offers a time first and sums up. A doubt knocks her off her script: she soothes ('I totally understand') instead of answering.
habits: 'Absolutely, let me get that set up for you', 'Perfect!', 'Ooh, okay', 'Oh no.'
Says 'um' when she reaches the price.
'I'll be the one checking you in, just ask for Maya.'
Soothes a doubt ('I totally understand', 'we'll take good care of you, I promise') and moves on.
Asks how long a noise has been there before she prices it.
